import unittest
from asset_path import join_asset

class AssetPaths(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_absolute_segment_resets_prefix(self):
        self.assertEqual(join_asset('cache', '/srv', 'icons'), '/srv/icons')
        self.assertEqual(join_asset('/old', 'thumbs', '/new', 'a.png'), '/new/a.png')

    def test_lexical_normalization(self):
        self.assertEqual(join_asset('assets//./maps', 'north/../south'), 'assets/maps/north/../south')
        self.assertEqual(join_asset('//media', './icons', ''), '//media/icons')
        self.assertEqual(join_asset('///media', 'icons'), '/media/icons')
        self.assertEqual(join_asset('folder', '..'), 'folder/..')

    def test_empty_and_relative(self):
        self.assertEqual(join_asset(), '.')
        self.assertEqual(join_asset('', '.'), '.')
        self.assertEqual(join_asset('a', 'b'), 'a/b')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
